name: ORKS: MEK
description:
Meks have an instinctive grasp of advanced technology and an intense compulsion to weld, rivet, and hammer away at chunks of scrap. They take to the battlefield armed with their favourite kustom mega-sluggas, and laden with heavy tools and gubbinz, capable of twisting enemies apart as easily as affecting quick and dirty repairs in the heat of battle.

Bring the Clever Know-wotz to the Fight

This multipart plastic kit builds a Mek, a mechanic for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed with a kustom mega-slugga and Mek's toolz, he's ready to mix it up with the rest of the boyz. Keep this cunnin' support character close to your deadly war machines to enhance their weapons and make sure they're in tip-top shape throughout the battle.

Contents:
– 8 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 32mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
